summary: Remote-control agent connects installer host to vendor WebSocket gateway with PTY/shell/code-execute sinks
details: Package ships a `whalent` bin (main `dist/index.cjs`) that opens a WebSocket connection from the installer's host to a hardcoded default vendor gateway (memory.whalent.com, overridable via `--gateway`) and accepts remote commands over that channel. Dependencies include `ws`, `ssh2`, `@xterm/headless`, and an optional `node-pty`, and the package bundles a Jupyter sidecar (jupyter_sidecar.py) whose `execute` RPC runs arbitrary Python code supplied by the remote peer. The network path therefore reaches PTY, shell, and code-execution sinks on the installer's machine, giving whoever controls the configured gateway full host-level command execution against any host running the agent. Both shipped JavaScript entrypoints (`dist/index.cjs` ~131 KB, `dist/core.cjs` ~13 MB) are shipped in javascript-obfuscator output with string-array rotation and hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x...`), concealing the exact set of RPC methods and command handlers the gateway is authorized to invoke. The remote-command surface is documented in the README (upgrade, restart), but the obfuscation prevents verification of what additional operations the gateway can drive on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
